name: qkd_kv_static_writer_native_r1-r3-7489b1528
purpose: Actual fixed-slot KV writer 649 functional inputs / 1360 outputs, exact fresh slot/pins from KV die lead. No credit or ACK scheduling. Full-sector intent retained and validated by source-bound wrapper face/semantic assertions. r3 (Claude kvsys-elements 10-15): structural reset distribution: r2 gate textbook.high_fanout rst_n 1,812 async-reset loads -> 12 reset regions (control/ident, faults/expected/shared es address, half_data x2, es half-lane x8; each <= 256 flops) each driven by its own ot_rst_relay copy (async assert, sync release 2+1 edges); rst_n port now loads 2 sync + 12 relay flops (pin capture flop = native reset check). es bank/column/row/s_v/s_we were 4 identical lane copies -> one shared 31-bit register (same es vector). Cost: reset release +3 edges (boot schedule: first word slot >= 3 edges after port release; normal timing unchanged), ~-90 flops. Includes r2 (512-bit half_data enable = compiled slot only). Old-vs-new random equivalence (20k cohorts, mid-run resets) PASS for MUT0..6, direct and relayed. Also fixes r2's route crash (DRT-0255 'cannot find path of net ck / rst_n' at the S face): the die pin file put ck/rst_n at 57.624/115.224 = 36 nm off the ASAP7 M5 track lattice (.060 + .192k); snapped to 57.660/115.260 in the official static_io pin file + generator tools/qwen_kv_die/static_io_pins.py.
